study_title: 선형계획모형을 활용한 유·무인 지뢰탐지 작업의 면적배분 최적화
substantive_decision_variables: 12 individually indexed areas; robot high-restriction area fixed to zero.
solver_variables: 12 area slots plus common time upper bound T (13 entries).
area_constraints: 3 terrain balances plus explicit redundant total-area double-sum equality.
time_constraints: 4 individual sums of area/capacity <= T over permitted pairs.
time_definition: Derived from area/capacity on permitted pairs; excluded pairs assigned zero.
primary_solution_policy: Store the primary LP areas unchanged. No human averaging, alternative-optimum enumeration or secondary optimization.
interpretation: Deterministic sensitivity levels, not an empirical probability distribution. Observed grid transitions are intervals, not exact thresholds.
execution_policy: Each scenario calls scipy.optimize.linprog directly once. Every result has a unique solver call ID and timestamps.
input_policy: This local JSON file is the standalone source of model inputs; no previous config is imported.
